plugins.name: Buff Overlay

changes: Works with the separate menu window (POEFixer 366): the host hands the plugin the right drawing context for its settings tab and for its overlay.
With the menu in a separate window, an icon dropped from the settings preview is freed only after both windows have drawn it (before, this could crash).
"Add tracker" and "Center on screen" place the tracker by the game's screen size, not by the size of a separate menu window.

plugins.name: Example Plugin
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Reference plugin for developers: live demos of every SDK service, from entities, buffs and inventories to the game UI tree, memory and prices.
changes: Works with the separate menu window (POEFixer 366): the host hands the plugin the right drawing context for its settings tab and for its overlay.

The example sets its drawing context at every entry point (OnEnable, DrawSettings, DrawUI), and the README explains why: with a separate menu window the settings tab and the overlay are drawn in two different ImGui contexts.

Its window now has the POEFixer gear menu (POEFixer 366): lock it, take it out of the game onto any screen, reset its position or close it; its place and size are remembered separately in and out of the game.

Shows the informational window helper (PluginInfoWindow.h) in the code and in a new README section; closing the window now saves "Show the info window", and the UI Explorer draws its on-game highlights after the window ended.

plugins.name: Farm Counter

changes: Works with the separate menu window (POEFixer 366): the host hands the plugin the right drawing context for its settings tab and for its overlay.
The settings tab also sets its drawing context itself, so it draws in the right window with the menu in a separate window.

Its windows (the counter and the separate Atziri beacons bar) now have the POEFixer gear menu (POEFixer 366): lock them, take them out of the game onto any screen, reset their position or close them; their places are remembered separately in and out of the game.

New setting "Show the counter window" (Settings tab); the counter's Close turns it off. Closing the separate beacons bar turns "Show as separate window" off, so the beacons go back into the counter window. Out of the game the counter stays movable and does not hide on mouse hover.
